name: IC Interface — 5V, 2.3V — TSSOP
description: Surface-mount interface IC cluster featuring 5V and 2.3V parts in TSSOP packaging with TSSOP-20 footprint support.
selection_hints: Select for interface IC applications requiring 5V or 2.3V operating voltage.
Choose when using TSSOP-20 (4.4x6.5mm, 0.65mm pitch) SMD land patterns.
Use when sourcing tier A KiCad symbol parts such as AD9834.
avoid_when: The board layout requires packages other than TSSOP.
Required operating voltages differ from 5V or 2.3V.
Through-hole mounting or non-SMD footprint is required.
